book.name: 1 KOLINITA
book.title: Kolinita wali Leta Houwan Pol wana Leleli

content: Keliso wana Yaomal te Pol I Papaatena-an
Taliwau ge nuwau, valila ya nowa ge Yehoba wasana ya papaatena-an, no baaba nige i oola toawabaaba ge tosiba hot wali baaba.
No minamina eliyamiu, ya ba nige bugul etega al na panpankiti-an, iyai te Yeisu Keliso ge wana yaomal kolos elana.
Sauga nau iyoho eliyamiu, tuwau i pweyata, alou no lovakun ge no ginu.

Sauga Wasa Waiwaisana ya panpankiti-an ge ya papaatena-an eliyamiu, baaba nige ya gogosibasiba-an tage nuwamiu na ba ahe, yaa no papaatena ginebi ge abapankite enuna toto i neem Yayaluwa Bwabwalena wana gasisi elana.
Inoke wami abulilek nige i tatalmililek gamagalau wali gosibasiba elana, yaa i talmililek Yehoba wana gasisi elana.
Yehoba wana Siba Ta Atena Yayaluwa Bwabwalena elana

Tunahot baaba nige ya gogosibasiba-an, yaa siba etegana ya baubaunan bolo yayaluwaliya i matuwa elal. He siba ya nige i neneem panayawiya, ge panayawi ana tologugui nige hi aatena, heliya wali gasisi i momomowasi.

Siba toto ya baubaunan i neem Yehoba elana, yaa i misumi ga. He mulaa abwe Yehoba panayawi i ginol, iyaka i nuwatu siba ya eliyana kila wana wasawasa ta pwawa, yaa sauga houhouwena Yehoba siba ya nige i papamasal gamagalau elal.
Panayawi ana tologugui siba ya nige etega hi aatena. Binimala wali aatena ni gan, he nige wasawasa ana Babala nihi lolokolos-an.

Tunahot siba ya Yehoba nige i papamasal, i ola Buki Bwabwalena ana leleli i ba, “Waisi toto Yehoba i lovivina-an bolo hi nunuwana-an kaiweliya, he nige sauga etega gamagalau hi kikite o ebo wasana hi hahago, ge nige sauga etega gamagalau hi nunuwatu-an.”

Yaa Yayaluwa Bwabwalena wana tuwalali eliyana, Yehoba siba toto valila i misumi iyaka i teli pamasal eliyala. Yayaluwa Bwabwalena bugul gegewena i atena, i ola al Yehoba wana nuwatu limwalimwanina i atena.
Nige etega wana pan gamagal wana nuwatu i aatena, gamagal o yayaluwana heiya te wana nuwatu i atena. I ola al, nige etega Yehoba wana nuwatu i aatena, Yehoba Yayaluwana ya te i atena.
Kila nige panayawi yayaluwana ta aahe yaa Yayaluwa toto i neem Yehoba elana, inoke bosowaila Yehoba wana mulolu toto i guyauan eliyala ta atena.

Inoke Yehoba wana mulolu o ha wasaan, ge wama baaba nige ha aahem gamagalau wali siba elana, yaa i neem Yayaluwa Bwabwalena wana panpankiti elana. Inoke Yayaluwa wana nuwatu ha pamasal gamagalau bolo Yayaluwa Bwabwalena i minaa elal.

Yaa bolo Yayaluwa Bwabwalena nige i miminaa elal, nige nuwaliya bugul bolo i neem Yehoba Yayaluwana elana nihi ahe, kaiwena hi nuwatu tage nige ali waisi etega i gagan. Nige bosowailiya ali sapu nihi atena kaiwena Yayaluwa Bwabwalena ya te bosowaina ali sapu ni pamasal.

Kilau bolo Yayaluwa Bwabwalena i minaa elala bosowaila bugul gegewena ali sapu ta atena. Yaa bolo Yayaluwa Bwabwalena nige i miminaa elal, nige etega bosowaina ni atenala ge ni pamasal wala aatena i sapu o ebo nigeya.
Kaiwena i ola Buki ana baaba, “Nige etega Babala wana nuwatu i aatena ge bosowaina ni panpankiti elana.” Yaa kila Babala Keliso wana nuwatu ta atena.
